brief.purpose: A local-first co-creative studio where designers and frontend builders work with AI to weave rough drafts into polished, editable, runnable interfaces
brief.concept: A compact anime-style weaverbird mascot logo, primarily a clever bird head or tight upper-body profile facing right. Give it one large expressive eye that conveys curiosity and a moment of inspiration, a sharp friendly beak holding a broad colorful weaving strand, and two or three large feather masses that suggest multiple collaborators. The strand should curve back into a simple nest loop or subtle capital-D silhouette, expressing drafts being woven into design. Keep the bird confident and inventive rather than babyish. No full scene, branch, realistic nest, individual feather texture, human clothing, words, robots, document pages, writing lines, code brackets, chat bubbles, or generic AI sparkle
brief.style: Japanese cel-shaded anime mascot translated into a production logo: expressive but compact, bold navy outline, flat two-tone color blocks, crisp silhouette, minimal facial detail, readable at 16 px, suitable for an app icon and brand lockup. Avoid photorealism, painterly rendering, gradients, glossy 3D, complex anime illustration, thin hairlines, tiny feathers, elaborate background, enclosing app tile, or mockup
brief.palette: midnight indigo outline #25224B, creative violet #7151F5, bright sky blue #32B8F2, warm coral #FF654F, golden eye and thread accent #FFC43D; no green
